description:
About Bask Health
 Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
 Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.
 We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.
 Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.
 About the Role
 We're looking for a Junior Full Stack Engineer to join Bask Health's engineering team and help build and improve the applications that power our telehealth platform.
 You'll work across frontend and backend development, contributing to user-facing features, APIs, databases, and integrations. Depending on the project, you may help develop merchant tools, patient experiences, internal applications, or shared platform functionality.
 This role is designed for an early-career engineer who has experience building web applications through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional work and wants to continue developing their full-stack engineering skills.
 You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver reliable, maintainable software. You'll receive technical guidance while gradually taking on more ownership of features and implementation decisions.
 We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, takes initiative, and is excited to grow into an engineer who can build and maintain features across the entire application stack.
 What You'll Do
 Build and improve full-stack features across Bask's web applications.
 Develop frontend interfaces using JavaScript, TypeScript, and React.
 Contribute to applications built with Next.js.
 Help implement backend functionality using Node.js and TypeScript.
 Build and integrate APIs connecting frontend applications with backend services.
 Work with SQL databases to retrieve, update, and manage application data.
 Contribute to merchant-facing and patient-facing application features.
 Help develop internal tools and operational workflows.
 Implement reusable frontend components and application functionality.
 Collaborate with product managers and designers to understand feature requirements.
 Translate technical specifications into working software.
 Assist with third-party API integrations.
 Help improve application responsiveness, usability, and accessibility.
 Investigate and resolve bugs across frontend and backend systems.
 Write readable, maintainable, and well-tested code.
 Participate in code reviews and incorporate technical feedback.
 Learn and apply best practices for authentication, authorization, and data security.
 Contribute to automated testing and quality assurance.
 Work with experienced engineers to understand application architecture.
 Help document technical changes and development processes.
 Participate in engineering planning and implementation discussions.
 Learn about cloud-based applications and deployment workflows.
 Use Git and collaborative development tools.
 Use AI-assisted development tools while understanding and validating generated code.
 Take increasing ownership of assigned engineering features and improvements.
 Requirements 
 
 Foundational software engineering experience gained through coursework, internships, personal projects, freelance work, or professional roles.
 Experience building web applications with both frontend and backend functionality.
 Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript.
 Familiarity with React or another modern frontend framework.
 Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive web development.
 Familiarity with Node.js or another backend development environment.
 Understanding of REST APIs and frontend-to-backend communication.
 Basic knowledge of SQL databases or relational data.
 Familiarity with asynchronous programming concepts.
 Understanding of reusable frontend components and application state.
 Ability to read, understand, and modify existing application code.
 Familiarity with Git and version control.
 Basic debugging and troubleshooting skills.
 Understanding of common software development and testing practices.
 Willingness to learn authentication, authorization, and application security principles.
 Ability to follow technical documentation and implementation guidance.
 Interest in building and maintaining production web applications.
 Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
 Ability to communicate technical questions, progress, and challenges clearly.
 Willingness to collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers.
 Openness to feedback, mentorship, and continuous learning.
 Ability to work independently on clearly defined tasks in a remote environment.
 Nice to Have
 Previous software engineering internship or junior development experience.
 Experience with TypeScript, React, and Next.js.
 Experience building backend applications with Node.js.
 Familiarity with SQL databases and ORM tools.
 Experience with Prisma or Drizzle ORM.
 Familiarity with tRPC or typed API frameworks.
 Exposure to AWS or another cloud platform.
 Familiarity with serverless application development.
 Experience using AWS Lambda or other cloud functions.
 Familiarity with SST or similar infrastructure frameworks.
 Experience with automated frontend or backend testing.
 Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and application deployment.
 Experience building SaaS applications or internal business tools.
 Familiarity with multi-tenant application concepts.
 Experience working in a TypeScript monorepo.
 Interest in e-commerce, merchant platforms, or subscription software.
 Interest in healthcare or telehealth technology.
 Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.
 A GitHub profile or portfolio demonstrating full-stack application projects.
